chapter: A Great Heart Fettered by Slender Chains
act_title: A Great Heart Fettered by Slender Chains

quests.title: A Great Heart Fettered by Slender Chains

dialogue.t: Hmm... Where could he have gone? And what about that girl's shadow? Paimon wonders how she's even connected to a giant guy like him...
...But honestly, Paimon has a feeling we're going to run into him somewhere else.
(You can feel the chill even as you draw close... In this environment, ice and snow of such thickness simply will not melt.)
(The faint sound of music seems closer now...)
(The door is sealed by frozen snow... It doesn't budge an inch.)
(But... you do hear a faint sound coming from behind that door.)

quests.description: Deep amidst the permafrost’s howling blizzards, a towering silhouette suddenly catches your eye… Why is it bound to these icy plains by chains forged from pure snow and ice?
